lines.t:
A <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c> where both teams send out 4 or more
<c:ffff00>{{medabot|pl}}<c>.
Up to 3 per team fight on the <c:ffff00>{{field}}<c> at once; when
one is <c:ffff00>{{knocked_out}}<c>, a {{reserve_battle_term}} {{medabot}} takes its
place.
There is no <c:ffff00>{{leader}}<c>; it continues until every {{medabot}}
on one team is {{knocked_out}}. A knocked-out {{medabot}}
can't be <c:ffff00>revived<c>.
